properties.description: Real-binary test (GitHub issue #616). Starts `--registry-root … --http 127.0.0.1:0` over roots holding real designs beside three unservable cases: a store whose identity sidecars were removed (the volume-mounted-at-the-store case), a store whose graph.id.json is unreadable, and an identity file whose store was removed. It asserts that startup stderr names each one with the remedy; that the listing on a bare GET / names it and, when nothing else is there, does not say "holds no designs"; that an unknown /g/<id>/ refusal says a store was found and not served; that a good design beside them is served; that an identity with no store is refused by name and NOT opened (no empty store is created under the old id); and that nothing mints an identity.
properties.name: a_registry_names_every_store_it_cannot_serve.rs — a registry names every store it found and cannot serve, at startup, in its listing and in its refusal, and never says "no designs" while one is there
